summary: The stdout return value holds normal output from command-line utilities run by modules like command, shell and raw.
questions: How do I get the output of a shell command into a variable?

answer_card.title: stdout return value
answer_card.answer_md:
**`stdout`** contains the normal output. Set by modules that run commands (`command`, `shell`, `raw`, etc.).

```yaml
- command: hostname
  register: r
- debug: var=r.stdout
```
